recipe.build:
sed -r '/signingConfigs.getByName/d ; /create\("release"\) \{/,/^        \}/d' -i android/app/build.gradle.kts
FLUTTER_VERSION="$(sed -rn 's/^\s*flutter-version:\ .([0-9\.]*).*?/\1/p' .github/workflows/release.yml | head -n 1)"
git clone -b $FLUTTER_VERSION https://github.com/flutter/flutter
export PUB_CACHE=$(pwd)/.pub-cache
flutter/bin/flutter config --no-analytics
flutter/bin/flutter pub get
flutter/bin/flutter build apk --release
find . -name '*.apk'
mv build/app/outputs/flutter-apk/app-release.apk /outputs/unsigned.apk

FLUTTER_VERSION="$(sed -rn 's/^\s*flutter-version:\ .([0-9\.]*).*?/\1/p' .github/workflows/release.yml | head -n 1)"

export PUB_CACHE=$(pwd)/.pub-cache
flutter/bin/flutter config --no-analytics
flutter/bin/flutter pub get
flutter/bin/flutter build apk --release
find . -name '*.apk'
mv build/app/outputs/flutter-apk/app-release.apk /outputs/unsigned.apk

recipe.build:
sed -r '/signingConfigs.getByName/d ; /create\("release"\) \{/,/^        \}/d' -i android/app/build.gradle.kts
FLUTTER_VERSION="$(sed -rn 's/^\s*flutter-version:\ .([0-9\.]*).*?/\1/p' .github/workflows/release.yml | head -n 1)"
git clone -b $FLUTTER_VERSION https://github.com/flutter/flutter
export PUB_CACHE=$(pwd)/.pub-cache
flutter/bin/flutter config --no-analytics
flutter/bin/flutter pub get
flutter/bin/flutter build apk --release
find . -name '*.apk'
mv build/app/outputs/flutter-apk/app-release.apk /outputs/unsigned.apk

recipe.build:
FLUTTER_VERSION="$(sed -rn 's/^\s*flutter-version:\ .([0-9\.]*).*?/\1/p' .github/workflows/release.yml | head -n 1)"
git clone -b $FLUTTER_VERSION https://github.com/flutter/flutter
export PUB_CACHE=$(pwd)/.pub-cache
flutter/bin/flutter config --no-analytics
flutter/bin/flutter pub get
sed -i -e 's/-Wl,/-Wl,--build-id=none,/' ${PUB_CACHE}/hosted/*/jni-*/src/CMakeLists.txt
flutter/bin/flutter build apk --release --split-per-abi --target-platform="android-arm64"
find . -name '*.apk'
mv build/app/outputs/flutter-apk/app-arm64-v8a-release.apk /outputs/unsigned.apk
